question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
track_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    t.Milliseconds / 60000.0 as duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.min_ms + ts.avg_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, track_stats ts
),
track_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.TrackId,
    tc.category,
    tc.duration_minutes,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as track_revenue
  FROM track_classified tc
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.TrackId, tc.category, tc.duration_minutes
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MIN(duration_minutes), 6) as min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(duration_minutes), 6) as max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(track_revenue), 2) as total_revenue
FROM track_revenue
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category

      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (ts.avg_ms + ts.max_ms) / 2.0 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, track_stats ts
),
track_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.TrackId,
    tc.category,
    tc.duration_minutes,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as track_revenue
  FROM track_classified tc
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY tc.TrackId, tc.category, tc.duration_minutes
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MIN(duration_minutes), 6) as min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(duration_minutes), 6) as max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(SUM(track_revenue), 2) as total_revenue
